_comment: Watchlist for scripts/check-sources.mjs. Each source has a fingerprint (lastSeen) captured when its figure was last vetted into the dashboard. The daily workflow flags a source only when its fingerprint actually moves. 'json' feeds are authoritative and low-noise; 'hash' pages are best-effort (gov portals often block bots or render client-side, so they stay null until a CI run reaches them and never false-flag).

sources.label: Union Budget scheme allocations — reconciled totals (urbanmorph/schemes register)
sources.note: Authoritative machine-readable feed; moves when a new budget cycle is parsed.

sources.label: Union Budget — centrally sponsored scheme lines (Stmt 4A, urbanmorph/schemes)
sources.note: Moves when FY2026-27 numbers are revised or a new fiscal year is published. Also the JJM budget signal.

sources.label: CGWB — Ground Water Resource Assessment landing page
sources.dashboardFigure: Dynamic GW Resources 2025: 730/6,762 units over-exploited (10.8%), stage 60.6%
sources.note: Best-effort: flags when the assessment page changes (e.g. a new annual report is linked). Blocked from some IPs; baselines on first successful CI fetch.

sources.note: Best-effort: flags around a new budget release so the budget feed can be re-pulled.
